original.text: anādinidhano buddha ādibuddho niranvayaḥ | jñānaikacakṣur amalo jñānamūrtis tathāgataḥ ||
original.edition: Mañjuśrīnāmasaṃgīti, GRETIL/DSBC e-text (IAST by the unit)
original.licence: GRETIL/DSBC e-text quoted for reference; terms of use as for the source file

paraphrase: Without beginning or end is the Buddha, the primordial buddha without lineage, with gnosis as the single eye, stainless, the embodiment of gnosis, the tathāgata.

original.text: tad yathā bhagavān buddhaḥ sambuddho 'kārasambhavaḥ | akāraḥ sarvavarṇāgryo mahārthaḥ paramākṣaraḥ || mahāprāṇo hy anutpādo vāgudāhāravarjitaḥ | sarvābhilāpahetvagryaḥ sarvavāksuprabhāsvaraḥ ||
original.edition: Mañjuśrīnāmasaṃgīti, GRETIL/DSBC e-text (IAST by the unit)
original.licence: GRETIL/DSBC e-text quoted for reference; terms of use as for the source file

paraphrase: The Lord, the Buddha, the perfect Buddha, arisen from the letter A; A, foremost of all letters, of great meaning, the supreme imperishable; the great breath, unborn, free of utterance, the chief cause of all expression, illuminating all speech.

original.edition: Mañjuśrīnāmasaṃgīti, GRETIL/DSBC e-text (IAST by the unit)
original.licence: GRETIL/DSBC e-text quoted for reference; terms of use as for the source file

paraphrase: Great, great, great passion bringing delight to all beings; great, great, great hatred, the great enemy of all afflictions.
